Consolidacion privada: distingue el binario optimizado de otra entrega que tambien se etiqueto 1.0.22. Sin cambios funcionales adicionales.
en: Tablet Radar: vehicle icons and blip contours matched to GTA V radar, independent slider for checkpoint and blip, renamed to "Tablet size", and updated initial default configuration.
Fewer repeated calculations when projecting map, icons and routes. Preserves layout and settings. Shared GPS computed outside the game with the updated HUD Remake.
pt: Tablet Radar: ícones de veículos e contorno de blips igualados ao radar GTA V, ajuste independente para checkpoint e blip, renomeado para "Tamanho do tablet" e configuração inicial padrão atualizada.
